scope: Historical development diagnostic; two fixed ACT policies on ten common starts
interpretation: Native actions were generated closed-loop from predicted observations, then replayed open-loop in MuJoCo. These are not calibrated evaluation probabilities.
source_check: Policy and seed identities matched; saved commands hash and replay controls matched; saved replay success flags recounted.
visual_example_rule: Smallest numeric shared seed: 62259; fixed frame indices 0, 50, 100 at 0, 10, 20 seconds.
training_scope: Task-adapted WorldGym checkpoint; not a zero-shot unseen-environment test.
